verses.1: On that day, Jehovah will bring about his severe, great, and powerful judgment upon Leviathan the serpent. He will also destroy Leviathan’s offspring, and he will kill those who are in the sea.
verses.2: On that day, Kerem Hamed Anu-Lah.
verses.3: I, Jehovah, will take care of her for a moment, so that she won’t be harmed during the night and day. I will protect her.
verses.4: I have no one to give me protection in battle. I will rely on her for protection during the war. We will be together.
verses.5: May he strengthen me in my weaknesses, and bring peace to me.
verses.6: Those who come will plant and grow; Jacob will flourish, and Israel will bloom. The faces of the sea will be filled with them.
verses.7: The one who strikes others is also struck. If he kills them, he will be killed in return.
verses.8: In Sasaah, through her sending, Trivena Haga was sent into the difficult wind on that day.
verses.9: Therefore, in this way, the sins of Jacob will be forgiven. All the fruits of his sin will be removed from him. All the stones of the altar will be scattered like loose stones; they will not be able to stand firm anymore.
verses.10: For a city that is in a desolate place, it will be abandoned and left to its own devices. There, a donkey will lie down, and there, a fox will roam around. All of its inhabitants will be destroyed.
verses.11: In the harvest time, it will be destroyed. Women will come out in the light of that day. For those who do not understand this, they will not be merciful. They who created it will not be saved.
verses.12: And on that day, Jehovah will divide the river into two parts—one part will be called “Nahal Mitzrayim,” and you will all be gathered together as one people, children of Israel.
verses.13: And on that day, he will be enthroned in a great throne. Then the exiles from Assyria and those who were banished from Egypt will come to worship Jehovah on the Holy Mountain in Jerusalem.
